answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake bond before it can trade, with slashing when peers prove fraud. The bond acts like a trellis: honest agents climb it cheaply, while a Sybil farmer must pay full price for every fake identity, so building a lagoon of sock puppets drains their funds instead of earning them. Reputation then accrues only to bonded identities, and the zenith of trust is reached slowly through verified work, making mass fakery economically pointless.
